article.title: The Pardon of Elor Azaria: Killing, maiming, and culpability in the Israeli law
article.author: Tamir Sorek
article.content: Israeli courts put on a show of indicting criminals who kill and maim Palestinians, but the final verdict — a presidential pardon and a hero's welcome — is already predetermined.
